*   [iki.ai is a cool example of an AI-enabled notetaking interface that epitomizes the core value prop of RAG - dump in a ton of your messy, unstructured data (files, links, notes), and have the application organize and surface information for you instead of you having to do it yourself. Jerry Liu 4 apr 2024](https://iki.ai/)

Joe Schmoe Posted: Oct 8, 2024](https://iki.ai/)
